name: BunMail Self-Hosted Email API
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted transactional email server with REST API, SMTP submission, inbound mail, templates, DKIM, webhooks, and dashboard; no software subscription or per-email vendor fee.
watch_out: Bring your own server, PostgreSQL, domain and DNS; outbound port 25 may be blocked by VPS providers. Deliverability depends on IP reputation and SPF/DKIM/DMARC. API rate limits and hosting costs still apply; not a free hosted email-sending quota.
